subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a read-only `openclaw approvals pending` command now, while keeping approval resolution and live watch behavior out of this first CLI surface?
rationale: The requested listing capability is bounded, but the active related PR combines it with commands that can resolve approvals; choosing whether that authority belongs in the CLI is a security and product-scope decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Sponsor read-only listing first
options.body: Implement an authorized table/JSON listing through the existing gateway method and defer resolve/watch behavior to separate reviewed work.

options.title: Sponsor listing and resolution together
options.body: Adopt the broader CLI workflow only after maintainers define its authorization, audit, and cross-surface behavior.

options.title: Defer to durable approvals work
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader durable approvals design establishes the canonical operator surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor read-only listing first
recommendation.body: Implement an authorized table/JSON listing through the existing gateway method and defer resolve/watch behavior to separate reviewed work.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current durable-approvals proposal and prior approvals-CLI review make them the clearest available routing candidate for the scope decision.
